topic: Pi Agent Core Guide 2026: The Runtime-Agnostic Framework Behind Flue and Agno

summary.core_insight: Pi Agent Core (pi-agent-core) is a minimal, runtime-agnostic TypeScript/JS agent harness by Mario Zechner (2.8M weekly npm downloads). It provides the foundational agent loop — tool execution, state management, event streaming — that sits between the LLM API layer (pi-ai) and higher-level frameworks. Two major frameworks build on it: Flue (from the Astro team) as a full-stack agent framework, and Agno as a production agent platform SDK. Cloudflare has adopted Pi as the harness in their three-layer agent architecture (Flue → Pi → Cloudflare Agents SDK).

pi_stack.pi_ai: Unified multi-provider LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)
pi_stack.pi_agent_core: Stateful agent runtime with tool execution, event streaming, steering/follow-up queues, hooks (beforeToolCall, afterToolCall)
pi_stack.pi_coding_agent: Full coding agent CLI with built-in file/shell tools, session persistence, extensions
pi_stack.pi_tui: Terminal UI library with differential rendering

three_layer_model.framework: Flue — project structure, conventions, CLI, DX for building agents
three_layer_model.harness: Pi / Project Think — agentic loop that calls tools, reads results, manages context
three_layer_model.runtime: Cloudflare Agents SDK — compute, state, storage primitives (durable execution, sandboxing)

agno_architecture.sdk: Agent definitions, tools, workflows (framework-agnostic; wraps Claude SDK, LangChain, etc.)
agno_architecture.agentos: FastAPI-based production runtime (50+ endpoints, SSE, WebSocket, session persistence, RBAC)

key_differences.pi_agent_core_vs_flue: Pi is a low-level harness (agent loop only, 4 default tools, minimal surface). Flue is a full framework (harness + CLI + sandbox + channels + multi-target deploy) built on Pi.
key_differences.pi_agent_core_vs_agno: Pi is TypeScript-first, minimal, harness-focused, 'agent extends itself' philosophy. Agno is Python-first, production-platform-focused, framework-agnostic wrapper with FastAPI runtime.
key_differences.flue_vs_agno: Flue is runtime-agnostic (Node, Cloudflare, CI/CD), TypeScript, harness-first. Agno is Python, opinionated about operational infra (auth, storage, RBAC), closed-source control plane.
key_differences.markdown_first: Flue treats agent instructions as Markdown files (skills) read at runtime — same skill works in Claude Code, Cursor, and production Flue deployments. Competitors treat agent playbooks as TypeScript code.

notable_properties.pi_philosophy: Minimal core (4 tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash), no MCP built-in, no sub-agents, no plan mode, agent extends itself via extensions, shortest system prompt of any agent harness, session portability across providers.
notable_properties.flue_innovations: Declarative agent definition (describe what agent knows, not what it does), durable streams (append-only event log for crash recovery), multi-target deployment (1 codebase → Node/Cloudflare/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), virtual sandbox (just-bash + Cloudflare Shell), four sandbox backends as framework contract.
notable_properties.agno_strengths: Framework-agnostic (wrap any agent SDK), 100+ integrations, human-in-the-loop approval system, OpenTelemetry out of the box, session persistence in your own DB, FastAPI-based production runtime.

market_positioning.adoption: pi-agent-core: 2.8M weekly npm downloads. Agno: 40K+ GitHub stars, 450+ contributors. Flue: 5K GitHub stars (as of June 2026), from Astro team, Cloudflare partnership.

ecosystem_players.batteries_included: Claude Agent SDK, Codex SDK, deepagents, LangGraph Cloud — polished, supported, production-ready but framework-locked
ecosystem_players.minimal_harness: Pi — small legible core, provider-portable, agent extends itself, rewards understanding over downloading
ecosystem_players.full_framework: Flue — harness-first, open at every layer, runtime-agnostic, markdown-driven agent skills
ecosystem_players.platform_sdk: Agno — framework-agnostic, operational infrastructure, Python ecosystem, FastAPI-based

cloudflare_relationship.announcement: June 17, 2026 — Cloudflare opened Agents SDK to any harness, with Flue as the first framework targeting it.
cloudflare_relationship.primitives: Durable execution (runFiber/stash/onFiberRecovered), Code Mode (dynamic Worker isolates for code execution, 10ms startup), Shell (SQLite-backed durable virtual filesystem), Dynamic Workflows (agent-written multi-step pipelines).
cloudflare_relationship.significance: Cloudflare validated the three-layer model and made Pi/Flue the open reference implementation for their platform, alongside their proprietary Project Think harness.
